LAW-0121: contrast-or-alternative preset, 16:9, t=0.70-1.00 (held final state): the leader from the 'Enlarged, then back in its line' chip below the book runs straight down from the 'record' key word through article lines 1-3 ('time.', 'copy', 'keeper', 'Other', 'request'), so it crosses the key article's text. Fix: route the leader outside the article frame (down the right margin rail, or out into the gutter) or place the chip beside the article. Add a semantic test that the leader polyline never intersects article text boxes, in every preset and ratio.

It settles over 'keeps a' in paragraph 1 ('Each unit ke[unit]register') instead of on the 'unit' token, which garbles the article line before it fades. The same misplacement shows with textVisibility none. Fix: aim the flight at the measured box of the key-word token in paragraph 1 (the box the highlight uses) and cross-fade into that highlight.

Default preset, 9:16, t~0.86: as the copy lifts off the passage it prints over the word that was just placed back, giving a garbled double word ('Ea[unit]it keeps'). Fix: start the copy only after the returned word has settled, and offset it upward before it starts travelling.

Minor: in 1:1 the article body text is about 14 px and the rack row labels about 12 px at 1080p, smaller than in the accepted LAW-0042. Consider enlarging the article and passage cards in the square layout.
LAW-0123: Default preset, 1:1, t~0.75-1.00 (hold), stage B: the blue connector from the book to the highlighted 'Source A' slot runs straight through the rack header ('Ordering supplied by the au|thor') and across the 'Source B' book in the Level 1 row before it reaches the slot. In 16:9 and 9:16 the same link is a short, clean leader. Minor: the rack row labels and book spines are about 11-13 px at 1080p in 16:9 and 9:16.

Minor, long-labels preset, 16:9, t=0.40: the inset is not centred on the key word, and 'unit' is clipped at the lens rim.
